claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 361 (Failure of integer-degree harmonic dimension comparison.; papers: A counterexample to integer-degree harmonic dimension comparison; A Three-Dimensional Counterexample to Integer-Degree Harmonic Dimension Comparison; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/361.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Under the explicit fixed-area angular, simple-crossing, protected-gap, and radial hypotheses H1-H6 of research/crossing_matching/theorem.md, every compact subset of the admissible exponent region admits one uniform late-start threshold. For every later start one common control sequence yields p independent exact invariant lines for actual whole-ball harmonic restriction, compatible entire harmonic functions, and exact spherical exponents equal to the continued-frequency means; a strict mean bound below k gives pointwise growth at most k.

For the actual whole-ball maps, positivity, constants and fixed-area mean preservation imply L2 contraction. Uniformly in all earlier histories, operator freezing is o(1), and freezing on the finite reference frame costs O(eta log(1/eta)+eta^2)=o(eta^q).

The protected angular gap and the two freezing estimates give a unique small future-dependent invariant graph, norm O(eta^q), and product-continuous outward matrices A_j=diag(exp(d_i(j)))+O(eta^q), with high-graph correction o(eta^q).

On each crossing plateau the outward off-diagonal entry is z_nu eta(t_nu)^q times the divided-difference coefficient q_b[lambda_h,lambda_i]<e_h,dot L e_i> plus o(eta^q), uniformly over all other controls. At equality the coefficient is exp(d(b^-2 lambda)) b^-2 dprime(b^-2 lambda)<e_h,dot L e_i>.

Stable crossing products have Gaussian Green scale eta^-1/2. Their signed mismatches have strict endpoint signs and size eta^(q-1/2), while trial columns have that same upper scale and lie inside eta^beta boxes. Finite Brouwer plus compactness gives one common product fixed point, satisfying every exact line recurrence.

Exact graph and line identities lift to independent entire harmonic functions. Their log spherical norms are m_i(n-J)+O(n^rho+n^(2-2rho)+n^(1-rho*q)+n^(1-rho)+1); all-radius contraction and uniform local elliptic estimates give pointwise degree-k growth when every m_i<k.

For arbitrary compact Hausdorff factor spaces, a continuous product self-map with a solution of every finite collection of coordinate fixed-point equations has a simultaneous fixed point. A clamped signed-control fixed point has zero mismatch, and normalized projective equations are exactly equivalent to finite-dimensional line invariance. Finite-dimensional Brouwer solvability and the PDE estimates are not assertions of this formal core.

The staged three-dimensional manuscript claims that every 4/9<v<1 and 1<c<9v/4, for all sufficiently large integers k, admit a smooth complete metric on R3 with nonnegative Ricci curvature, AVR v, and at least c(k+1)^2 independent harmonic functions of pointwise growth at most k. This main theorem is not settled by the current matching-only mission.

The staged angular-program proposition n:prop-angular-program supplies the finite protected cluster, linearly split double crossings with independent nonzero crossing directions, and all continued-frequency means strictly below k. Its geometric existence proof remains outside the present mission.

The staged radial proposition n:prop-radial-realization supplies the stated fixed-area smooth global family for all controls, nonnegative Ricci curvature, and the uniform radial and angular estimates. Its curvature and realization proof remains outside the present mission.

The selected finite cluster dimension p=(floor(vartheta*k)+1)^2 is at least c(k+1)^2 at a common cofinite threshold; this numerical selection and the angular existence threshold remain separate from matching.
The separate higher-dimensional Berger manuscript construction and its simultaneous controls, transmission, geometry, and growth require an independent audit and remain open.

For the actual whole-ball maps, positivity, constants and fixed-area mean preservation imply L2 contraction. Uniformly in all earlier histories, operator freezing is o(1), and freezing on the finite reference frame costs O(eta log(1/eta)+eta^2)=o(eta^q).

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Set

namespace CrossingMatching

theorem product_fixedPoint_of_finite
    {I : Type*} {K : I → Type*}
    [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (K i)] [∀ i, CompactSpace (K i)]
    [∀ i, T2Space (K i)]
    (Φ : (∀ i, K i) → (∀ i, K i)) (hΦ : Continuous Φ)
    (hfinite : ∀ s : Finset I, ∃ x, ∀ i ∈ s, Φ x i = x i) :
    ∃ x, Φ x = x := by
  classical
  let C : I → Set (∀ i, K i) := fun i => {x | Φ x i = x i}
  have hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (C i) := by
    intro i
    exact isClosed_eq ((continuous_apply i).comp hΦ) (continuous_apply i)
  have hnonempty : ∀ s : Finset I, (⋂ i ∈ s, C i).Nonempty := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hfinite s
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    simp only [mem_iInter]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := CompactSpace.iInter_nonempty hclosed hnonempty
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  funext i
  exact mem_iInter.mp hx i

def clamp (x : ℝ) : ℝ := max (-1) (min 1 x)

theorem clamp_fixed_forces_zero
    (z d : ℝ) (hz : -1 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1)
    (hplus : z = 1 → 0 < d) (hminus : z = -1 → d < 0)
    (hfix : z = clamp (z - d)) : d = 0 := by
  unfold clamp at hfix
  have htop : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    have hd := hplus he
    have ht : max (-1 : ℝ) (min 1 (z - d)) < 1 :=
      max_lt (by norm_num)
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith))
    linarith
  have hbot : z ≠ -1 := by
    intro he
    have hd := hminus he
    have ht : (-1 : ℝ) < min 1 (z - d) :=
      lt_min (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have hb := lt_of_lt_of_le ht (le_max_right (-1 : ℝ) (min 1 (z - d)))
    linarith
  rcases le_total (z - d) 1 with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_right h] at hfix
    by_cases hm : -1 ≤ z - d
    · rw [max_eq_right hm] at hfix
      linarith
    · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hm)] at hfix
      exact (hbot hfix).elim
  · rw [min_eq_left h] at hfix
    rw [show max (-1 : ℝ) 1 = 1 by norm_num] at hfix
    exact (htop hfix).elim

theorem normalized_line_iff
    {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (v w : Fin n → ℝ) (hw : w i = 1)
    (σ : ℝ) (hσ : σ = (A.mulVec v) i) (hσ0 : σ ≠ 0) :
    A.mulVec v = σ • w ↔
      ∀ h, h ≠ i → (A.mulVec v) h / σ = w h := by
  constructor
  · intro he h _
    have hh := congrFun he h
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hh
    apply (div_eq_iff hσ0).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hh
  · intro he
    funext h
    by_cases hi : h = i
    · subst h
      simp [Pi.smul_apply, hw, hσ]
    · have hh := (div_eq_iff hσ0).1 (he h hi)
      simpa [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hh

#print axioms product_fixedPoint_of_finite
#print axioms clamp_fixed_forces_zero
#print axioms normalized_line_iff

end CrossingMatching

claims.natural_statement: The complete parameter-uniform whole-ball matching and pointwise growth theorem in research/crossing_matching/theorem.md remains valid for isolated odd-order double crossings with maximal order D, when q>D/(D+1) and beta<q-D/(D+1). Trial columns are O(eta^(q-D/(D+1))), and each signed mismatch at an event of order d_nu has endpoint magnitude at least c eta^(q-d_nu/(d_nu+1)). Smooth phase stalls realize these higher-order angular hypotheses from simple crossings while preserving any strict mean-frequency margin.

On a sign interval bounded by odd-order crossings of orders at most D, stable products of length m satisfy W(m)<=C exp(-c eta^D m^(D+1)); their Green sum is O(eta^(-D/(D+1))). At a crossing of order d_nu, a central window of eta^(-d_nu/(d_nu+1)) steps has uniformly positive incoming weights. The resulting signed mismatch dominates the exponentially suppressed outside-plateau tail uniformly in every other variable.

routes.retired_because: Finite spectral arithmetic, finite truncations, or projective algebra alone do not prove actual whole-ball uniformity or countably simultaneous matching. They are auxiliary checks only, not a route to the claimed analytic theorem.
